summary_bullets: Re-enable /design run-log publishing so completed design runs flush durable logs again.
Make the design-log admin merge fail closed until required checks register for the pushed head and pass.
Document and cover the distinct registration-timeout, CI-failure, and stale-head paths.
commit_message:
Re-enable design log publish merge gate

Restore the /design run-log publish call and its failure-envelope coverage.

Require required CI checks to register for the pushed head before watching them, fail closed with dedicated registration-timeout diagnostics, and keep the existing --admin merge only after the registered checks pass.

Update the design-log publish, design-publish, and SECURITY contracts to describe the head-bound registration gate.
